message: Hi, my kid Kai is 8 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?
Hey! Yes, we do! We have Kids Jiu-Jitsu classes for ages 8-12+ that meet Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday. Kai would fit right in. Would you like to book a free trial class for him?
Yes, that sounds great! Can we book the first available class?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial confirmation to?
You can send the confirmation to tester.heron@gmail.com.
Got it! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Perfect! Now I just need Kai's full name and date of birth to get him registered for the trial.
Kai Heron, and his birthday is June 10, 2018.

Awesome! I have a few options for Kai's trial class. The earliest is Wednesday, July 8th at 5:00 PM. I also have Monday, July 13th at 5:00 PM or Wednesday, July 15th at 5:00 PM. Which works best for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8th at 5:00 PM.
Perfect! Kai is all set for Wednesday, July 8th at 5:00 PM. Confirmation has been sent to tester.heron@gmail.com. Just have him wear comfortable athletic clothes. Looking forward to seeing you both!
